content_type.description: ContentType is how a deploy treats a file: raw writes its bytes as they are; template renders it with Go text/template and the agent's facts.
content_type.title: ContentType

interval.description: Interval is how often a scheduled job runs, in place of a cron schedule.
interval.title: Interval

name.description: The entry, and its file name, such as backup

object.description: The object that holds the entry, from osapi client file upload

schedule.description: A cron expression, such as */5 * * * *; give it or interval

user.description: The user the entry runs as

vars.description: The vars of a template, as key=value
